headline: Oil Prices Plunge on Draft Proposal for U.S.-Iran Conflict Resolution
summary: Oil prices slumped by 3% in Asian trade following reports that a draft proposal to end the U.S.-Iran war is being circulated after negotiations in Qatar.
why: Crude oil is a primary global energy commodity whose price heavily influences international energy costs, inflation metrics, and the valuation of major energy corporations.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Oil prices slumped by 3% amid renewed optimism about a possible peace deal.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The circulation of a draft proposal to end the conflict reduced geopolitical risk premiums, prompting a 3% drop in oil prices during Asian and early U.S. trading hours.
